verdict.rationale: Insomnia is marketed as an open-source desktop app with local environments, scripts, and even local AI model options (kong-docs-6, kong-docs-19, kong-docs-34), and decK CLI works locally without a cloud account (kong-probe-4). However, community evidence directly contradicts full offline use, noting 'Insomnia REST client now requires an account' and complaints about 'bloat' driving users to alternatives (kong-comm-3, kong-comm-4).
